$comment: Dependencies that must ship inside the npm package but are NOT in this
reads this file instead of restating the list, so importing a bare
specifier that only exists as a devDependency is a change made here,
in the same commit as the import.
`scripts/check-package-manifest.mjs` fails the build when a bare import in
src/ is covered by none of: `dependencies`, `peerDependencies`, this file,
or a theme path alias from tsconfig.json `paths`. That is the
'anything an injected route imports must be a real dependency' rule,
enforced at the source instead of at package time.
A version range here overrides nothing: the packaging repo copies these
